\[p(x_t|x_{t-1})= \mathcal{N}(x_t;\sqrt{1-\beta_t}x_{t-1},\beta_t I)\] \[\begin{aligned} x_t &= \sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_t}x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_t}\epsilon\\ \epsilon &\sim \mathcal{N}(0,I) \end{aligned}\] 
python go.py

The forward process is

\[\begin{equation} q(x_t|x_{t-1}) = \mathcal N \left( \sqrt{1-\beta_t}\,x_{t-1}, \beta_t I \right). \label{eq:forward} \end{equation}\]

The reverse process in Equation (\ref{eq:forward}) defines the Markov chain used during diffusion.
